children: Oman has issued OMR 26.9 million ($69.94 million) in treasury bills to help fund operating expenses.

The financial instruments are split into three tranches, with the 91-day bills allotted OMR 20.4 million at an average yield of 3.84298%, while those maturing in 182 and 364 days are allotted OMR 5.5 million at 3.95720% and OMR 1 million at 3.95012%, respectively.

The treasury bills have been issued by the Central Bank of Oman on behalf of the government. The T-bills are also designed to help commercial lenders invest their surplus funds and boost the local money market.
The repo rate for the period July 30, 2026 to September 16, 2026 is 4.25%.
(Writing by Cleofe Maceda; editing by Seban Scaria) seban.scaria@lseg.com

title: Oman issues nearly $70mln in treasury bills as yields top nearly 4%
